newsitem.title: UK: NBC sees MSNBC Europe launch in late 1997.
newsitem.headline: NBC sees MSNBC Europe launch in late 1997.

text.p: MSNBC, the cable television joint venture of General Electric Co's NBC and Microsoft Corp , is expected to launch in Europe in late 1997, Roger Ogden, president and managing director of NBC Europe, said on Tuesday.
The venture is working on developing sufficient European programme content and distribution before launching in Europe.
"In late '97 we would intend to launch," Ogden told a news conference.
